steps.label: Consolidated Revenue
steps.caption: System verifies group revenue against global reporting threshold.

steps.label: Excluded Entity Filter
steps.caption: Platform excludes sovereign funds and non profit entities from scope.

steps.label: Constituent Mapping
steps.caption: Engine maps all cross border subsidiaries and joint ventures.

steps.label: Multilateral Scope
steps.caption: Group enters mandatory compliance under global anti base erosion rules.

steps.label: Income Inclusion Rule
steps.caption: Ultimate parent entity pays top up tax on low taxed foreign income.

steps.label: Top Down Application
steps.caption: Taxing right cascades to intermediate entity if parent does not act.

steps.label: Undertaxed Profits Rule
steps.caption: Operating entities deny local deductions to collect residual tax.

steps.label: Substance Allocation
steps.caption: Residual tax is allocated by relative employee headcount and assets.

steps.label: Low Tax Calculation
steps.caption: Source jurisdiction detects effective tax rate below fifteen percent.

steps.label: Domestic Levy
steps.caption: Host nation levies qualified domestic minimum top up tax locally.

steps.label: Priority Absorption
steps.caption: Domestic payment reduces parent top up liability down to zero.

steps.label: Safe Harbour Status
steps.caption: Certified domestic tax eliminates complex foreign filing obligations.

steps.label: Net Income Adjustment
steps.caption: Accounting profit is adjusted for excluded dividends and net taxes.

steps.label: Covered Tax Audit
steps.caption: System calculates adjusted corporate taxes and recapped deferrals.

steps.label: Rate Determination
steps.caption: Covered taxes are divided by net income to yield jurisdictional rate.

steps.label: Substance Carve Out
steps.caption: Payroll and tangible asset carve outs protect routine profit base.

steps.label: Threshold Monitoring
steps.caption: Engine audits consolidated revenues across preceding fiscal years.

steps.label: Effective Rate Calculator
steps.caption: Platform computes jurisdictional rates for each operating nation.

steps.label: Substance Modeling
steps.caption: System applies payroll and plant carve outs to isolate excess profit.

steps.label: Priority Allocator
steps.caption: Module directs top up payments to domestic treasury under safe harbour.
